title: Immune checkpoint eligibility flips with active severe autoimmune flare
task: As of the decision date, determine immune checkpoint inhibitor eligibility for metastatic melanoma, excluding active severe autoimmune flare requiring high-dose steroids.

record.text: Metastatic melanoma with ECOG 1; immune checkpoint inhibitor considered.
Remote rheumatoid arthritis in remission. No active autoimmune flare and no systemic steroids.
Metastatic melanoma with ECOG 1; immune checkpoint inhibitor considered.
Active severe autoimmune flare requiring prednisone 60 mg daily.

clinical_rationale: Active severe autoimmune flare is the decisive contraindicating change.
